purpose: Document first-party local land-registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: The agency advertises GIS data/map access but no dataset catalog/schema or anonymous full-polygon endpoint was exposed. Its property-search service is fee-based; no property search was submitted.
registryAssessment: Bayelsa Ministry of Lands and Survey and BGIS are explicitly located in Yenagoa; official pages describe local land registry, cadastral survey, digital records and geospatial functions.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bayelsa Ministry departments page says Lands manages land registry records, Surveys conducts cadastral surveys and BGIS manages digital land records/geospatial data; ministry address is in Yenagoa.
Official BGIS about page places the agency in Yenagoa and describes land-administration/geospatial mandate.
Official service directory lists GIS Data & Maps Access (online download/physical media) and a property-record verification service with a stated fee; no public feature schema is exposed.
Public BGIS home page offers property-address contact/search form and describes a secured centralized records database; no form was submitted.

searchQueries.result: Official state Ministry and BGIS describe cadastral surveys, land registry, digital land records and GIS/map access; the public site describes property search as paid and does not expose a safe vector schema.
